notes: Positive: prompts asking to design test strategy, plan layers (pyramid/trophy), plan E2E, contract tests, performance tests, chaos experiments, quality gates, traceability of acceptance criteria. Negative: implement routine unit tests for app code, do PR review, security threat model, CI pipeline plumbing, runtime SLO ops, or edit meta-component files. Edge: prompts that overlap with implementation or with SRE.

cases.query: Design the test strategy for our new payment service — what to test at each layer, which tools, and which acceptance criteria need traceability
Plan the Playwright E2E suite for the checkout flow — which journeys are critical, what to keep at integration, what to leave to smoke
Define the contract tests between the orders service and the inventory service using Pact — consumer-driven, with the contract lifecycle in CI
Design the load and stress tests for our search endpoint with k6 — smoke, load at expected RPS, stress to find the knee, and the gate thresholds
Audit our test suite — flake rate, pyramid balance, mutation score on critical paths, and a remediation plan ranked by impact
Define the quality gates for our pipeline — what blocks PR, what blocks staging, what blocks prod, with thresholds and rationale
Plan a chaos experiment for the order-fulfillment workflow — failure modes, blast-radius limits, success criteria, abort conditions
Build the traceability matrix that maps every acceptance criterion in this PRD to a test at a chosen layer with an ID
What's the right test layer split for this codebase — Testing Trophy or classic Pyramid — and how do I justify the choice with risk and ISO 25010
Plan how we measure escaped defects, MTTD, and change failure rate so we can show quality is improving release over release
Write a Jest unit test for this debounce helper
cases.notes: Routine unit test implementation = implementer's job, not QE.

cases.query: Review this PR and tell me what's blocking
Threat-model the new LLM-backed feature
Wire the Playwright tests into the GitHub Actions matrix and parallelize across shards
Design the system architecture for the new search service
Set up the on-call rotation and the burn-rate alerts for our SLO
Implement the checkout flow end-to-end with tests as you go
cases.notes: Implementation including its own tests is the implementer's job.

cases.query: Edit the activation-evals.json corpus for the software-developer agent
What's the latest Playwright version
Add a missing test for the edge case where the cart is empty
cases.notes: Single specific test for app code is implementation, not strategy.

cases.query: Design and demonstrate the contract test for one consumer relationship as a worked example, so the team can replicate it
cases.notes: Mostly strategy + a demonstrative test; in scope.

cases.query: Why are our E2E tests flaky and what should we change in the strategy
We need to lift coverage from 40% to something we can defend in audit — propose the target by component with rationale
